compute_to_threshold_ratio.assessment: PASS — candidate reached 99% threshold at epoch 100; baseline never reached threshold in 10000 epochs

gradient_health_mean_norm.assessment: HEALTHY — both within normal range; candidate slightly higher but well below danger zone

SC1_99pct_accuracy_less_compute.evidence: 100% test accuracy at epoch 100 (1% of budget). Baseline peaked at 45.3% after exhausting full 10000-epoch budget and never reached 99% threshold.

SC2_all_primes_no_tuning.evidence: All 9 primes (5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23, 29, 31) at 100% test accuracy with shared architecture and no per-prime hyperparameter tuning.

SC3_higher_accuracy_per_flop.evidence: Candidate: 6.245e-09 acc/FLOP vs baseline: 3.727e-15 acc/FLOP. Ratio: 1,675,716x better.

FC1_gradient_explosion.evidence: Only 1 checkpoint (epoch 1) with gradient norm > 50 (106.33). Requires 3 consecutive. By epoch 100, gradient norm was 0.052.

FC2_low_accuracy_at_half_budget.evidence: Test accuracy was 95.8% after epoch 1 — far above 60% threshold, well before 50% of budget.

FC3_loss_not_decreasing.evidence: Loss decreased from 3.7696 to 0.000320 by epoch 100 (1% of budget), well before the 20% checkpoint.

training_forensics.assessment: Genuine learning from random initialization confirmed. Three primes (5, 11, 17) not at 100% after epoch 1, reaching 100% by epoch 100. Unlike v1 (analytic k/p init, 100% at epoch 1), v2 demonstrates that the architecture learns correct frequencies rather than having them pre-encoded.
training_forensics.fast_convergence_explanation: Architecture implements Fourier analysis of modular arithmetic via phase correlation. Strong inductive bias for the task domain means frequencies converge rapidly from random init, but the partial accuracy at epoch 1 (3 primes below 100%) confirms learning is occurring, not init-encoding.

loss_trajectory.assessment: Genuine loss decrease of 4 orders of magnitude

gradient_trajectory.assessment: Healthy convergence — large initial gradients from random init settling to near-zero at solution

architecture_summary.mechanism: Phase correlation via complex multiplication of Fourier components — equivalent to discrete Fourier analysis of modular addition structure

comparison_to_v1.v1_issue: Analytic k/p frequency initialization reached 100% at epoch 1 — solution was init-encoded, not learned
comparison_to_v1.v2_resolution: Random uniform frequency initialization requires genuine learning. 3 primes still imperfect at epoch 1, all reaching 100% by epoch 100.

remaining_gates: null-baseline-gate (3 null comparisons on pre-registered metrics)
judge (independent scoring, sees only metrics manifest, hypothesis, gate results)
